content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not use a single verse's failure to state a link or its contrary as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED; it relies on the defender's dropped limb leaving no live link.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"single verse does not state a link or its contrary ... never a ground: broad reading forbids any UNDERDETERMINED tied to one verse; narrow reading forbids only when that single-verse nonstatement is the stated ground.","why":"The stated ground is the dropped curse limb and absence of a live link to contradict, not the insufficiency of a single verse, so K-S2 is not breached."}
